verdict.rationale: Typesense's first-party docs cover the full collection workflow through the API: create a collection, add documents, then search and filter. They also state the complete API surface ships in the open-source server. A first-party Typesense Cloud MCP server lets an agent build collections and index data from the conversation, with a documented `claude mcp add` command. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent running the loop end to end, explicit confirmation that queries can be run through the MCP server (docs say "tune search"), MCP coverage for self-hosted deployments, and detail on the CLI beyond a single mention.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my coding agent can create an index, add documents, and run queries end to end — through the API, CLI, or MCP without touching a dashboard
